purpose: Research capture for future plot-style presets; not an installed ILM theme format.

palettes.name: Colorful
palettes.proposed_use: Discrete categories. Same color set as Wong, with a different ordering.

palettes.name: Muted Rainbow
palettes.proposed_use: Preserve as an optional legacy appearance. Continuous use needs an explicit value-to-color mapping.

palettes.name: Ocean
palettes.proposed_use: Ordered series or sequential values. Pale end colors need visible outlines on white.

palettes.name: Wong / Okabe-Ito
palettes.proposed_use: Discrete categories, with markers/dashes available as additional distinctions.

palettes.name: Blue–Pink
palettes.proposed_use: Ordered or diverging appearance. Preserve the exact source order; do not assume a numerical midpoint.

palettes.name: Blue–Red
palettes.proposed_use: Diverging values around an explicitly configured reference. Pale center colors also need consideration for thin lines.

palettes.name: Blue–Red · Preserve Ends
palettes.proposed_use: Legacy ordered-series alternative without the near-white center of Blue–Red. It is a separate palette.

palettes.name: Purple–Brown
palettes.proposed_use: Preserve as an optional custom palette. Pale colors work better as outlined fills than unoutlined thin lines.
